quickAnswer: Cleaning an 8,000 sq ft corporate wing averages $671 to $1,416 per visit across weekly-to-daily schedules on commercial carpet (1.00x national average), totaling $9,477 to $15,990/month at 3x/week ($729–$1,230/visit) and $15,003 to $25,330/month at 5x/week ($693–$1,170/visit) with three restrooms. Adding a fourth restroom brings 3x/week totals to $744 to $1,260/visit ($9,672–$16,380/month) and 5x/week totals to $708 to $1,200/visit ($15,328–$25,980/month).

blocks.text: An **8,000 sq ft corporate wing** sits in a uniquely strategic spot in commercial janitorial pricing. Under national rate tables, 8,000 sq ft still falls inside the **2,500–9,999 sq ft bracket (`$0.09–$0.15/sq ft` base)**—right before the **10,000 sq ft tier drop (`$0.07–$0.12/sq ft`)**.

That bracket boundary matters when you negotiate multi-year contracts. As our tables below show, an 8,000 sq ft wing with four restrooms actually calculates slightly higher at the low end (`$9,672/month` at 3x/week) than a [10,000 sq ft full floor](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-10000-sq-ft-office/) (`$9,425/month` at 3x/week). Smart facility managers use that exact math—alongside regional metro adjustments and restroom line items—to secure blended-bracket concessions.
8,000 Sq Ft Contract Math: 3 Restrooms vs. 4 Restrooms

Corporate wings of 8,000 sq ft typically house 50 to 65 employees and split between **three restrooms** (`$45–$90/visit`) or **four restrooms** (`$60–$120/visit`) when separate department cores or executive suites are present. Every schedule below multiplies per-visit pricing by exact **4.333 weeks per month** visit counts (`13.0` visits/month at 3x/week; `21.65` at 5x/week).

blocks.title: Use the 10,000 Sq Ft Bracket Step-Down as Negotiation Leverage
blocks.text: Because 8,000 sq ft prices at $0.09–$0.15/sq ft while 10,000 sq ft drops to $0.07–$0.12/sq ft, an 8,000 sq ft wing with 4 restrooms ($9,672–$16,380/mo at 3x/wk) exceeds a 10,000 sq ft floor ($9,425–$16,380/mo). Ask bidders for a blended $0.08–$0.13/sq ft enterprise rate—or bundle adjacent storage/annex space to qualify for the 10,000+ sq ft tier.
Regional Metro Multipliers and Annual Contract Totals

Across multi-city corporate portfolios, metro wage multipliers (`0.85x` to `1.35x`) create swings of **$4,700 to $8,500+ per month** on an 8,000 sq ft wing. The matrix below applies our national city-index tiers to commercial carpet across 3x/week and 5x/week contracts, including the impact of all four turnkey add-ons.

blocks.text: *Adding **breakroom sanitation (`+$12–$25/visit`)**, **interior glass (`+$15–$35/visit`)**, **paper/soap consumables (`+$96–$200/visit`)**, and **amortized quarterly floor care (`+$240–$480/month`)** raises a 1.00x, 4-restroom corporate wing from `$15,328–$25,980/month` to `$18,231–$32,089/month` on a 5x/week schedule (`$183,938–$311,760` base annual spend vs. `$218,772–$385,068` turnkey).
Floor Finishes and ISSA Crew Time on an 8,000 Sq Ft Wing

At ISSA production rates (`2,800 to 4,000 sq ft/hr` plus `0.15 to 0.25 hrs` per restroom), an 8,000 sq ft wing requires **2.45 to 3.61 labor hours per visit** with three restrooms, or **2.60 to 3.86 labor hours** with four restrooms (`2.29 hrs` floor pass at 3,500 sq ft/hr). Most commercial contractors deploy a **2-person crew for 1.5 to 2.0 clock hours** per evening using high-filtration uprights (compare performance in our [SEBO Automatic X7 commercial vacuum review](/commercial-vacuums-and-floor-machines/sebo-automatic-x7-commercial-vacuum-review/)).

blocks.text: Color-Coded Wet Mopping Equipment for Corporate Wings

Corporate wings typically mix carpeted executive corridors, hardwood boardrooms, and tiled multi-stall restrooms. Keeping three specialized floor tools in your janitorial closet prevents cross-contamination and water damage to wood subfloors:

items: **Rubbermaid Commercial HYGEN Charging Bucket:** Stores up to 20 pre-soaked, color-coded microfiber pads beneath a snap lid so crews switch to a fresh OSHA-ready pad in every restroom and hallway without double-dipping.
**O-Cedar ProMist MAX Commercial Microfiber Spray Mop:** Uses a 14.5-inch double-sided washable pad and onboard refillable spray reservoir for controlled, low-moisture hardwood boardroom maintenance.

**O-Cedar Commercial 24-oz Looped-End Cotton Wet Mop:** Built with a 5-inch heavy-duty tailband and launderable blue/white looped cotton yarns to scrub heavy restroom tile, grout, and VCT service vestibules.

blocks.title: Corporate Wing COI, Security Access, and OSHA Standards
blocks.text: Multi-tenant corporate wings require tighter access controls than standalone suites. Enforce background-checked W-2 technicians, key-card audit logs, a $1M/$2M General Liability COI naming both your corporation and building owner as Additional Insured, Workers' Compensation, a fidelity bond, plus OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS binders and Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) compliance.

items.text: Confirm 3x/week quotes cover 13.0 visits/month and 5x/week quotes cover 21.65 visits/month with zero fifth-week surcharges.

items.text: Require written shift-hour minimums and evening badge-in logs matching ISSA production benchmarks for your restroom count.

items.text: Price carpet hot-water extraction and VCT scrub-and-recoat ($240–$480/month amortized) on a clear quarterly schedule so performance is verifiable.

faqs.q: How much does it cost per visit and per month to clean an 8,000 sq ft office?
faqs.a: At the 1.00x US average on commercial carpet, an 8,000 sq ft corporate wing with three restrooms runs $729 to $1,230/visit ($9,477 to $15,990/month) at 3x/week and $693 to $1,170/visit ($15,003 to $25,330/month) at 5x/week. With four restrooms, 3x/week totals $744 to $1,260/visit ($9,672 to $16,380/month) and 5x/week totals $708 to $1,200/visit ($15,328 to $25,980/month).

faqs.q: Why can an 8,000 sq ft office cost nearly the same as a 10,000 sq ft office?
faqs.a: Our pricing brackets drop from $0.09–$0.15/sq ft (2,500–9,999 sq ft) to $0.07–$0.12/sq ft once a facility reaches 10,000 sq ft. With four restrooms at 3x/week, an 8,000 sq ft suite ($9,672–$16,380/month) slightly exceeds a 10,000 sq ft suite ($9,425–$16,380/month) at the low end—giving 8,000 sq ft tenants leverage to negotiate blended-tier discounts.

faqs.q: How many labor hours should an 8,000 sq ft cleaning crew spend per visit?
faqs.a: Using ISSA commercial standards (2,800–4,000 sq ft/hr plus 0.15–0.25 hours per restroom), an 8,000 sq ft corporate wing takes 2.45 to 3.61 labor hours with three restrooms or 2.60 to 3.86 labor hours with four restrooms—usually staffed by two technicians working 1.5 to 2.0 clock hours.

faqs.q: What is the standard hourly rate for extra deep cleaning or day-porter coverage?
faqs.a: Routine general cleaning labor in US commercial markets bills at $35 to $65 per hour (adjusted by city cost multipliers from 0.85x to 1.35x), while specialty tasks—such as OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens remediation, post-construction HEPA cleaning, or machine floor restoration—bill at $55 to $95 per hour.

faqs.q: What insurance and green-cleaning documentation should be in an 8,000 sq ft RFP?
faqs.a: Require a Certificate of Insurance ($1M/$2M General Liability naming tenant and landlord as Additional Insured, Workers' Compensation, and fidelity bond), OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) Safety Data Sheets, Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) training, and Green Seal GS-37 or EPA Safer Choice chemical specifications if your building holds LEED certification.
